fields.name: demo_moves
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters, one per leg of the demonstration video, written at the first decision step and copied unchanged at every later step. A leg runs from one highlighted target to the moment a different target becomes highlighted (the gripper has reached the next target). Count one leg at EVERY change of the highlighted target: the number of letters equals the number of highlight changes in the demonstration, including legs that return to a target already visited, legs lasting only a few frames, and a change that appears only in the last demonstration frame; never merge or skip a leg because the gripper comes back to where it was. A frame showing two targets highlighted at once is the change frame: the leg ends there and the next leg starts there, the newly highlighted target being the new one. Letter for a leg: compare the x of the new target with the x of the previous target; smaller x is RIGHT, larger x is LEFT. Then look at the gripper's y in the frames strictly between the two highlight changes of that leg against the y of the stick (cube) it passed between the two targets: smaller y means it passed the backward side, larger y the forward side. LEFT+backward=A, RIGHT+forward=B, LEFT+forward=C, RIGHT+backward=D. The list has as many letters as legs in the demonstration, and it equals the sequence of recorded subgoals of the episode. Written as a single-quoted list, comma and space between letters, never double quotes. e.g. ['A', 'B', 'A', 'D']

fields.name: legs_done
fields.description: Number of execution legs the robot has completed so far, i.e. the index of the decision step counting from zero: 0 at the first decision step, 1 at the second, 2 at the third, and so on. It is the index into demo_moves of the subgoal to issue now. e.g. 1
